The paper does not report any squalene production figures for HBQA7 (or any other strain). Squalene is mentioned only once, as an example of an *untapped* opportunity: the authors note that "there is untapped potential for fatty acid derivatives…, polyketides…, and longer-chain terpenoids (e.g., taxadiene, squalene, β-carotene)" (p. 11).

The terpenoids actually reported as produced in engineered HBQA7 include isoprenol, isoprene, geraniol, α-pinene, (S)-limonene, S-(+)-linalool, 1,8-cineole, (E)-nerolidol, β-caryophyllene, and (−)-α-bisabolol (Table 2, p. 9).
